## Checklist

- [ ] Pages [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#-page-likhna) wali shape follow karte hain aur unme caption ke saath kam se kam ek diagram hai
- [ ] Breadcrumb, "Is page par" list aur footer maujood hain
- [ ] Naye ya move kiye pages chapter README, `README.md` aur `SUMMARY.md` mein listed hain
- [ ] Saare relative links aur anchors kaam karte hain
- [ ] Code snippets bataye gaye versions ke saath chalte hain
- [ ] Naye terms [GLOSSARY.md](../GLOSSARY.md) mein hain aur pehli baar use hone par link kiye gaye hain
- [ ] Difficulty badge aur padhne ka time set hai
- [ ] Facts ke sources diye hain; koi copy kiya text ya image nahi
- [ ] Main maanta/maanti hoon ki mera contribution CC BY 4.0 (content) aur MIT (code) ke under licensed hai
